statement: A 1.7 kg block is released from rest and slides 2.3 m down a 24 degree incline with coefficient of kinetic friction 0.13. At the bottom it moves onto a frictionless horizontal surface and runs into a spring of stiffness 410 N/m. Take g = 9.81 m/s^2. Find the maximum compression of the spring.
notes: x = sqrt(m*v^2/k), v^2 = 2*d*g*(sin(theta) - mu*cos(theta)). v^2 = 12.995193 m^2/s^2.
